full_judgment: 15. The trial Court at first dismissed the suit on the ground of insufficient evidence, but subsequently decreed the same on an application of review under section Order XLVII, rule-1 of the Civil Procedure Code. Subsequently the defendant appellant preferred an appeal before the District Judge, Khulna which was allowed and against such order of reversal, the present plaintiff (opposite party) filed the revisional application before the Single Bench of the High Court Division wherein the learned Judge of the Single Bench set aside the judgment of the Courts below and with an order of sending the case on remand along with a direction to the trial Court to take evidence and thereafter disposed of the suit on merit.
